entities.summary: Ansgar Beckermann is a German philosopher who deals primarily with philosophy of mind and epistemology. He is professor for philosophy at the University of Bielefeld and was the president of the "Gesellschaft für analytische Philosophie". Beckermann is known for his arguments for physicalism and his discussion of the concept of emergence.
